REVOLUTIONISING WELLNESS: INGENIOUS FOR YOU AND THE PLANET

At INGENIOUS, our dedication to sustainability shines through in every aspect of our ingredient sourcing. We partner with those who share our commitment to responsible and ethical practices, ensuring our products are both effective and environmentally friendly.

Our key ingredients—Marine Collagen, Astaxanthin, and Hyaluronic Acid—exemplify this approach.

Marine Collagen 

Unlike bovine and porcine collagen, which often come from animals bred for meat production, our marine collagen peptides are sustainably sourced from the skin of free-swimming Tilapia fish. 

Clinical research shows that marine collagen from cold-water fish offers unparalleled purity and effectiveness, with superior bioavailability compared to bovine or porcine sources. We source our collagen peptides from Marine Stewardship Council (MSC) certified fisheries, ensuring sustainable seafood practices and protecting marine life. Our peptides comply with stringent international food regulations and are non-GMO, free from antibiotics, hormones, preservatives, heavy metals, and toxins. 

Astaxanthin

Our natural astaxanthin is sourced from the microalgae Haematococcus pluvialis in a pristine Swedish archipelago, renowned for its powerful antioxidant properties. Our supplier, with over 35 years of research and innovation, maintains high sustainability standards and rigorous food safety protocols. In partnership with Vattenfall, excess heat from production now heats 20% of Gustavsberg’s residential area, showcasing their commitment to sustainability. 

Hyaluronic Acid 

We use a pioneering Hyaluronan Complex that delivers results which a demonstratively superior to those of traditional HA formulas. Developed with eco-friendly ingredients, our approach ensures a minimal environmental footprint. Our supplier upholds responsible and transparent practices, with certifications for good manufacturing, environmental management, food safety, health and safety, and quality management.

Every INGENIOUS formula is free from gluten, dairy, wheat, artificial colours, sulphates, caffeine, parabens, shellfish, and soya. All ingredients are certified.

INGENIOUS supplements are crafted with care and integrity, ensuring you receive the safest, most effective products while supporting a healthier planet.
